import pandas as pd

def run(inputs: dict[str, pd.DataFrame]) -> dict[str, pd.DataFrame]:
    crm_feed = inputs["crm_feed"].copy()
    web_feed = inputs["web_feed"].copy()

    crm_feed["src_rank"] = 1
    web_feed["src_rank"] = 2

    stg_combined = pd.concat([crm_feed, web_feed], ignore_index=True)

    # Order by src_rank ASC, updated_at DESC, email ASC (within customer_id partitions)
    stg_sorted = stg_combined.sort_values(
        by=["src_rank", "updated_at", "email"],
        ascending=[True, False, True],
        na_position="last",
        kind="mergesort",  # stable sort
    )

    # Keep first row per customer_id after sorting by priority
    golden = stg_sorted.drop_duplicates(subset="customer_id", keep="first")

    golden = golden[["customer_id", "email", "updated_at"]].reset_index(drop=True)

    return {"golden": golden}
